Why send a Legal Notice?
Before you go to court, make your position clear.
A legal notice formally communicates your grievance, your demand, and gives the other party an opportunity to respond.
Acts as evidence in court
Clearly states your demand
Opens an opportunity to resolve the dispute
May help avoid unnecessary litigation
